name: Burgundy Wool Coat
short_description: A double-faced wool coat in deep burgundy, cut to sit over a chunky knit.
description:
Our warmest coat, in a double-faced wool with a brushed finish on both sides, so it needs no lining. A relaxed shoulder leaves room for knitwear, and deep welt pockets sit where your hands fall.

Care. Dry flat after a cool hand wash, or use a wool cycle at 30 degrees. Fold rather than hang.

reviews.author: Tom W.
reviews.content: A beautiful coat. It runs slightly large, so size down if you are between sizes.

reviews.author: Hannah M.
reviews.content: Heavier and better made than anything I have bought in years. It arrived in two days, beautifully packed.

name: Grey Wool Coat
short_description: A mid-weight wool coat in heathered grey that goes with everything.
description:
Woven in a mill that has made coating cloth for three generations, with a soft handle and a subtle fleck. Single-breasted, with horn buttons and a full cupro lining.

Care. Dry flat after a cool hand wash, or use a wool cycle at 30 degrees. Fold rather than hang.

name: Faux Fur Gilet
short_description: A sleeveless faux fur layer in warm camel, lined in soft jersey.
description:
All the warmth of a gilet with none of the bulk under a coat. The pile is dense and soft, the lining is brushed jersey, and it hooks closed at the front.

Care. Spot clean only. Brush gently with a soft brush.

name: Chunky Knit Jumper
short_description: A relaxed, hand-finished jumper in a soft wool blend.
description:
Knitted on hand-operated machines and finished by hand, with dropped shoulders, deep ribbed cuffs and a gently cropped body.

Care. Dry flat after a cool hand wash, or use a wool cycle at 30 degrees. Fold rather than hang.

reviews.author: Lena K.
reviews.content: The cosiest thing I own. Worth every penny.

reviews.author: Daniel R.
reviews.content: I sent back one size and had the swap within the week, no questions asked.

name: Cream Cardigan
short_description: A long, loose cardigan in undyed cream wool.
description:
Cut long enough to wrap, with horn buttons and patch pockets. The yarn is undyed, so the cream is the natural colour of the wool.

Care. Dry flat after a cool hand wash, or use a wool cycle at 30 degrees. Fold rather than hang.

name: Everyday Grey Sweater
short_description: The crew neck we wear more than anything else, in soft grey marl.
description:
A fine gauge that layers under a coat and a weight that works on its own. Ribbed hem and cuffs keep their shape wash after wash.

Care. Dry flat after a cool hand wash, or use a wool cycle at 30 degrees. Fold rather than hang.

name: Grey Sweater Dress
short_description: A soft knit dress with bell sleeves, cut above the knee.
description:
Knitted in a light, warm yarn with a subtle rib, so it skims rather than clings. The bell sleeves are wide enough to push up.

Care. Dry flat after a cool hand wash, or use a wool cycle at 30 degrees. Fold rather than hang.

name: Mustard Knit Dress
short_description: A ribbed midi dress in warm mustard, with a tie waist.
description:
Knitted in a fine rib that holds its shape, with a detachable tie at the waist and a length that works with boots.

Care. Dry flat after a cool hand wash, or use a wool cycle at 30 degrees. Fold rather than hang.

name: Pink Silk Blouse
short_description: A washed silk blouse in pale pink, with a relaxed fit.
description:
Sand-washed silk with a soft, matte finish. A camp collar, a chest pocket and a curved hem that looks right tucked or loose.

Care. Hand wash cold or dry clean. Cool iron on the reverse.

name: Leopard Print Tee
short_description: A cotton tee in a small leopard print.
description:
Heavyweight organic cotton jersey, garment dyed and printed, with a slightly boxy fit.

Care. Machine wash at 30 degrees with similar colours. Warm iron.

name: Black Poplin Shirt
short_description: A crisp cotton poplin shirt in black.
description:
Tightly woven poplin with a clean collar, mother-of-pearl buttons and a back yoke with a small pleat for movement.

Care. Machine wash at 30 degrees with similar colours. Warm iron.

name: White Poplin Shirt
short_description: The white shirt, in crisp organic cotton poplin.
description:
Tightly woven poplin with a clean collar, mother-of-pearl buttons and a back yoke with a small pleat for movement.

Care. Machine wash at 30 degrees with similar colours. Warm iron.

name: Floral Chain Bag
short_description: A structured shoulder bag in a dark floral print.
description:
Printed canvas with leather trim, a chain strap that doubles for a short handle, and a magnetic clasp. Fits a phone, keys and a small wallet.

Care. Wipe with a dry cloth.

name: Patent Clutch
short_description: A slim black patent clutch for evenings out.
description:
Glossy patent leather with a zip top and a suede-lined interior.

Care. Wipe with a soft dry cloth.

name: Leather Messenger Bag
short_description: A vegetable-tanned leather bag that ages beautifully.
description:
Thick, vegetable-tanned leather with brass buckles, two front pockets and a padded sleeve that fits a 13-inch laptop.

Care. Condition the leather twice a year.

name: Quilted Ankle Boots
short_description: Black leather ankle boots with a quilted panel and a stacked heel.
description:
Soft leather uppers, a quilted side panel, an inside zip and a rubber sole with grip for wet pavements.

Care. Wipe clean and use a leather protector.

name: Strappy Heeled Boots
short_description: Cut-out heeled boots in black suede.
description:
Soft suede with strap cut-outs, a slim heel and a cushioned insole.

Care. Brush with a suede brush.

name: Round Frame Glasses
short_description: Round wire frames with clear lenses.
description:
Lightweight metal frames with adjustable nose pads and spring hinges. Supplied with a linen case.

Care. Clean with the cloth supplied.

name: Merino Rollneck
short_description: Fine-gauge merino with a soft rolled neck. Light enough to layer, warm enough on its own.
description:
Knitted from extra-fine merino in a relaxed fit, with a rolled neck that folds down or wears up. The model is 178cm and wears a size M.

Care. Dry flat after a cool hand wash, or use a wool cycle at 30 degrees. Fold rather than hang.

reviews.author: Priya S.
reviews.content: Soft, warm and it still looks new after a winter of wearing it almost every day.
